summary: Kerb backing onto dense bush on a quiet estate street; homes across the road.
reasons: Backs onto dense bush, no homes this side
Houses about 20 m across the road
Quiet estate street, no cars parked here

drivers.traffic: Quiet residential loop serving the estate.
drivers.convention: One car parks on the opposite side; no parking convention on the bush kerb itself.
